title: Meet Tootie, Get a Sky View of an Arrest, and Answer the Call – The Blue Notebook Review 10/26–11/1
description: In this week’s Blue Notebook, Sgt. Verbeck has a special request for our viewers, walks through several notable incidents, and shares a sky-view perspective of a recent arrest. He also introduces a prehistoric visitor who stopped by the studio, and closes out the episode by answering your questions and reading your comments.
